item.description: The event will be attended by social partners, governments and other key stakeholders who will engage in discussion on the current state of the art and define priorities to be addressed through regulation and policymaking, to promote healthy psychosocial work environments and good mental health at work in the future of work.

item.title: Career Opportunity: University of Passau W3 Chair in Developmental and Health Psychology - EAOHP
item.description: The University of Passau is currently advertising a W3 Chair in Developmental and Health Psychology at the Faculty of Social and Educational Sciences, starting on 1 October 2026. The focus is on school-related research, particularly on learning and developmental disorders, stress prevention, and the use of digital media. The application deadline is 26 November 2025.
